name: XCW World Championship
epitaph: Held by Sting across both of the fed's own surviving 1997 broadcasts, retaining against Davey Boy Smith by disqualification on 17 November and facing a title challenge laid down by a debuting Taz on 7 December.

name: XCW United States Championship
epitaph: Held by Dean Malenko as of the fed's 7 December 1997 broadcast, named there by a debuting Taz as the only champion "worth a damn" on the roster.

name: XCW Television Championship
epitaph: Won by Randy Orton from Orlando Jordan at the wing's own 11 October 2004 Clash Of The Titans, still champion at this wing's own record's end; the belt changed hands at least three further times earlier in this wing's own 2003 partition (Goldberg, Taz, Jeff Jarrett attested) without a fully reconstructed chain.

name: XCW World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Introduced by a single-elimination tournament beginning at the wing's own 17 July 2003 Superclash I; its first champions are not attested in this wing's own surviving record. Al Snow and Bob Holly won the title on the wing's own 7 October 2004 Wednesday Night Warfare and were still champions at this wing's own record's end.
